title: qstab: Quaternion Stability Toolbox

creators.name: Šebek, Michael
creators.affiliation: Czech Technical University in Prague, Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Department of Control Engineering

description:
qstab is a MATLAB toolbox for nominal and robust strict stability of scalar quaternionic polynomials, right spectra of quaternion state matrices, stability margins, witnesses and sampled family plots. Version 0.19.0 adds degree/parity Hurwitz face enumeration, single-component interval frequency margins, analytic simple norm-root derivatives, 24 interval-article example groups and optional exact rational certificate replay.

The 0.19.0-rc.1 sources passed 731 native MATLAB R2024b Update 2 regression checks with no failures or skips. A separate native interval study matched all 24 groups and 110 comparisons. The final release changes version/documentation text and two plot labels; numerical algorithms and tests are unchanged. The numerical checks, independent Python/SymPy proof replay and optional MATLAB Symbolic replay have distinct assurance scopes documented in the validation record.
